metadata.title: AITAH for Skipping My Brother’s Gender Reveal?
metadata.subtitle: My parents disowned me in the group chat for refusing to fly home—because I’m the only one who noticed his "pregnant" fiancée matches a missing-person sketch.

nodes.text: 3:15 PM · Your family group chat is on fire. Your parents just called you jealous and selfish for canceling your flight to Ethan’s gender reveal party.
Thanks for ruining Mom’s weekend, Harper. Amber is six months pregnant and crying because you refuse to meet her!
Ethan, zoom in on the birthmark under Amber’s left ear. Have you ever checked the 2021 Amber Alert database?
Ethan, tell your sister to stay away from the party—I don’t want anyone taking photos of me!

nodes.transcript: [urgent tone] "Hi Harper, this is Agent Brooks from Missing Persons. You submitted a tip 20 minutes ago—that photo of ‘Amber’ is a 98% match for missing heiress Clara Vance!"

nodes.prompt: Wait—if Amber is the missing woman, why is she terrified of photos?!

options.label: Ask Agent Brooks if she’s a victim or suspect
options.player_reply_text: Hold on—is she running FROM someone, or did she fake her disappearance?!

options.label: Book the last evening flight home immediately

nodes.text: Agent Brooks lowers his voice—revealing a twist that turns your stomach cold.
Clara Vance didn’t vanish alone—her first husband died in a house fire the exact same night. She’s a person of interest!
You book the 6:00 PM flight home while Agent Brooks dispatches state detectives to meet you at the airport.
Smart move—do NOT warn Ethan over text in case she’s reading his phone!
Your brother thinks he’s having a baby with the love of his life—while sleeping beside a homicide fugitive.
Whatever, stay in Chicago. Amber says she’s taking me to her uncle’s cabin after the party anyway.

nodes.headline: Cabin After The Party
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Fake Ultrasound — You land home and meet Agent Brooks outside the arrival gate.

nodes.text: 7:40 PM · You land home and meet Agent Brooks outside the arrival gate. One look at the ultrasound photo Ethan posted in the family chat makes Brooks freeze.
Look at the corner of Amber’s ultrasound photo—the watermark date says "2018." She downloaded it off a stock medical forum!
She isn’t even pregnant?! Then why is she rushing Ethan to a remote mountain cabin tomorrow?!
Ethan, did your life-insurance policy switch beneficiary to me today like you promised?

nodes.transcript: [grim voice] "That’s her exact M.O.! In 2021, her first husband added her to a $1.5M life-insurance policy 48 hours before his cabin burned down!"

nodes.prompt: Your brother’s gender reveal starts at 10 AM tomorrow—and he’s signing the beneficiary form tonight:

options.label: Drive straight to Ethan’s house with Brooks
options.player_reply_text: Don’t wait for morning—stop him before he signs that insurance form tonight!

options.label: Call your mom discreetly to get Ethan outside

nodes.text: You pull up to Ethan’s street—watching a bright porch light glow while Amber’s silhouette moves behind the curtains.
Wait—we need a clean DNA swab from a glass or cup to confirm she’s Clara Vance before arresting!
Mom steps out onto her porch puzzled—until you show her the 2018 watermark on Amber’s ultrasound.
Wait—my daughter-in-law isn’t pregnant?! Give me my coat, I’m getting Ethan out right now!
Amber spots headlights outside and immediately draws the living room blinds tight.
Mom just texted you’re in town?! Harper, if you’re outside trying to start drama, leave NOW!

nodes.headline: Behind Drawn Blinds
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Coffee Cup Swab — You play it smart: apologize to Ethan so he lets you attend the gender reveal—just long enough for Mom to hand Agent Brooks Amber’s used coffee cup..

nodes.text: 9:00 AM · You play it smart: apologize to Ethan so he lets you attend the gender reveal—just long enough for Mom to hand Agent Brooks Amber’s used coffee cup.
Rush lab just finished running the lip-rim swab from Amber’s mug against Clara Vance’s 2021 dental-clinic sample!
Tell me we have a match before Ethan cuts that pink-or-blue cake.
Ethan, let’s leave for the mountain cabin right after cake—your sister keeps staring at me weirdly!

nodes.transcript: [sharp triumph] "100% MATCH! ‘Amber’ IS Clara Vance! Arrest warrant is live—do NOT let Ethan get into her SUV!"

nodes.caption: State Forensics Rush DNA Match — 99.99% match confirming "Amber" is 2021 fire-homicide fugitive Clara Vance.

nodes.prompt: Guests gather around the backyard cannon while Amber edges toward her parked SUV:

options.label: Block the driveway & show Ethan the DNA match
options.player_reply_text: Ethan, STOP! Her name is Clara Vance and she isn’t even pregnant!

options.label: Wait 30 seconds for Brooks’s unmarked vans

nodes.text: Amber’s fake pregnancy pillow slips slightly under her sundress as she whirls around in fury.
Don’t listen to her, Ethan!! Get in the car—we’re leaving NOW!!
Two unmarked sedans roar into the cul-de-sac, blocking Amber’s SUV bumper-to-bumper.
Cops?! Ethan, give me the car keys—I’m not going back!!
In front of forty stunned relatives, Amber rips off her silicone belly pad and sprints toward the backyard woods!
Her belly... it was foam?! Harper... who did I almost marry?!

nodes.headline: The Silicone Belly Drops
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: Into The Pine Woods — Chaos erupts in the yard.

nodes.text: 10:30 AM · Chaos erupts in the yard. Amber vanished into the pine ravine behind your parents’ house—where she stashed a second getaway car.
K9 unit is tracking her scent down the creek trail! Stay inside with Ethan—she may be armed!
Wait—Ethan just noticed his dad’s cabin keys are missing from the kitchen hook!
I knew Harper would ruin everything—heading to the mountain cabin to grab my cash!

nodes.transcript: [radio static] "She didn’t go to her uncle’s cabin—she’s driving toward YOUR family’s empty cabin on Cedar Ridge!"

nodes.prompt: Ethan realizes she already stashed gasoline cans at your dad’s cabin last week:

options.label: Give Agent Brooks the Cedar Ridge shortcut
options.player_reply_text: Take Old Mill Road, Agent Brooks—it cuts 15 minutes off Cedar Ridge!

options.label: Check the cabin’s solar trail camera remotely

nodes.text: Brooks’s tactical cruisers peel out onto Old Mill Road with sirens screaming.
We’ll beat her to Cedar Ridge by five minutes!
You open the cabin trail-cam app—showing an accomplice already unlocking your father’s porch door!
WHOA—she’s NOT working alone!! There’s a man inside your cabin right now!
Your brother stares at the live trail-cam feed—recognizing the man instantly: the "insurance broker" who pushed him to sign the $1.5M policy.
That’s the insurance guy who came to my office!! They were going to kill me at Dad’s cabin!!

nodes.headline: The Insurance Accomplice
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Cedar Ridge Setup — The whole sinister puzzle locks into place: Amber and the crooked insurance broker ran a two-person "black widow" ring across three states..

nodes.text: 11:15 AM · The whole sinister puzzle locks into place: Amber and the crooked insurance broker ran a two-person "black widow" ring across three states.
State troopers just surrounded Cedar Ridge Cabin! Wait—Amber spotted the cruiser dust and stopped half a mile down the dirt road!
Cut the cabin’s remote generator power so her partner thinks the storm knocked out his signal!
Why aren’t you answering the radio?! Are the cops at the cabin?!

nodes.transcript: [whispered from tree line] "We just cuffed the insurance broker quietly on the back porch—now we have HIS radio!"

nodes.prompt: Agent Brooks asks how to draw Amber straight into the clearing:

options.label: Have Ethan text her "Mom bought your story"
options.player_reply_text: Text her from Ethan’s phone: "I ditched my sister. Meet me at the cabin alone."

options.label: Let Brooks mimic the broker’s all-clear signal

nodes.text: Amber buys Ethan’s text immediately—her dark SUV roaring up the gravel driveway two minutes later.
She’s in the driveway! Spike strips deployed behind her tires!
Brooks taps the broker’s radio twice—their secret "all clear" code. Amber drives straight into the tactical ring.
Engine surrounded—nowhere left to run!
Amber slams her SUV into reverse—flattening all four tires on the steel spike strip.
Wait—she jumped out of the passenger door and ducked into the old root cellar tunnel behind the cabin!

nodes.headline: Into The Dark Cellar
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Root Cellar Standoff — The 1970s root cellar under your dad’s cabin has only one hidden air-vent exit—which only you and Ethan know from childhood..

nodes.text: 11:45 AM · The 1970s root cellar under your dad’s cabin has only one hidden air-vent exit—which only you and Ethan know from childhood.
Harper, remember the rusted hatch behind the cedar stump?! If she crawls out there, she hits the highway!
Tell Agent Brooks to put two officers on the cedar stump hatch RIGHT NOW!
I found the old vent hatch—ten feet to the highway and I’m gone!

nodes.transcript: [crunching leaves] "Officers are standing right over the cedar stump hatch! We hear someone pushing up from underneath!"

nodes.text: [wind howling] "We have thermal lock on two heat signatures inside the root cellar—Amber is holding a flare near the wooden hatch! Give us ten seconds to flank!"
Thermal lock confirms two people inside the root cellar! Hold your position—flank team is 10 seconds out!

nodes.prompt: Amber shoves the rusted hatch open—expecting an empty highway:

options.label: Have officers seal her exit & demand surrender
options.player_reply_text: Game over, Clara Vance! Hands up and crawl out slowly!

options.label: Wait until she pulls her cash satchel up first

nodes.text: Two troopers grab her wrists the second she clears the hatch—cuffing the 2021 fugitive cleanly.
Clara Vance is IN CUSTODY! Zero injuries!
She heaves a waterproof satchel stuffed with four stolen passports and $90,000 onto the grass—right into Agent Brooks’s boots.
Caught with all the 2021 murder-insurance evidence in her own hands!
Back at your parents’ house, Ethan drops onto the porch steps, finally grasping how close he came to dying in a "cabin accident."
Wait—we found one more dark photo on the insurance broker’s phone from last night... someone stood outside YOUR parents’ upstairs window!

nodes.headline: The Corridor Shadow
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: Last Night’s Stalker — Agent Brooks sends you a chilling photo recovered from the broker’s phone: a shadowy figure standing inside your parents’ dark upstairs hallway at 2:14 AM..

nodes.text: 1:10 PM · Agent Brooks sends you a chilling photo recovered from the broker’s phone: a shadowy figure standing inside your parents’ dark upstairs hallway at 2:14 AM.
The broker took this inside your parents’ house at 2:14 AM—Amber unlocked the side door so he could copy Ethan’s signature from his desk!
They were going to forge the life-insurance beneficiary form even if Ethan hesitated!
She unlocked our parents’ house at 2 AM while Mom and Dad were sleeping ten feet away?!

nodes.transcript: [calm reassurance] "Both Amber and the broker are denied bail on capital conspiracy and 2021 homicide charges. Your family is completely safe now."

nodes.caption: Recovered Phone Photo · 02:14 AM — dark silhouette of the insurance accomplice inside the upstairs hallway.

nodes.prompt: Your parents’ group chat goes quiet as you drop the official FBI arrest notice inside:

options.label: Ask if they still think you’re selfish
options.player_reply_text: Still want to disown me for skipping the gender reveal, or are we good?

options.label: Call Mom directly & hug it out in person

nodes.text: Your dad sends a five-paragraph apology—and immediately reimburses your emergency flight three times over.
I owe you my literal life, Harper. I’ll never doubt you again.
Mom bursts through the kitchen door sobbing and wraps both you and Ethan in the tightest hug of her life.
Thank God you didn’t ignore that birthmark, sweetheart!!
The gender-reveal balloons still bob gently in the backyard—now a reminder of the narrowest escape in family history.
Clara Vance’s late first husband’s family just called our office—they want to thank you for finally solving his 2021 murder.

nodes.headline: A 2021 Cold Case Solved
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Grand Jury — Six weeks later.

nodes.text: 2:00 PM · Six weeks later. The insurance broker turns state’s witness—confessing to both the 2021 arson murder and the Cedar Ridge plot.
Indictment returned: life without parole on the table for Clara Vance. Zero chance she ever hurts another family.
Give my best to her first husband’s parents, Agent Brooks.
Also—I canceled every single life-insurance policy until I’m 50 and married to someone YOU approve!

nodes.transcript: [warm chuckle] "You’ve got sharper eyes than half my rookie squad, Harper. Ever consider forensic analysis?"

nodes.prompt: Ethan asks what he can possibly do to make up for how the family treated you:

options.label: Demand lifetime free dinners & holiday truce
options.player_reply_text: Every Thanksgiving for the next ten years, you do ALL the dishes.

options.label: Ask the family to fund a missing-persons fund

nodes.text: Ethan laughs loudly—relieved to feel normal again for the first time in weeks.
Ten years of dishes—signed and notarized!
Your parents match your donation to the National Missing Persons Network in honor of the 2021 victim.
Turning our family’s scariest day into something genuinely good!
A cold case from 2021 finally rests in peace—because one sister looked twice at a photo.
Come home for Sunday barbecue? Zero foam bellies, I promise.

nodes.headline: Sunday Barbecue
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Real Family Toast — Warm evening breeze over the same backyard.

nodes.text: 5:30 PM · Warm evening breeze over the same backyard. No gender-reveal cannons—just ribs on the grill, real laughter, and a grateful brother.
Mom made your favorite lemon pie—and put a "World’s Best Detective" candle right on top.
Better than being disowned in the group chat, I’ll admit.
Sentencing confirmed: life without parole. Enjoy that lemon pie!

nodes.transcript: [warm laugh] "Everyone’s raising their glasses—come blow out the detective candle, sis!"

nodes.prompt: Your family gathers around the backyard table smiling:

options.label: Toast to Ethan staying alive & single
options.player_reply_text: To trusting red flags—and to my brother surviving his own terrible taste!

options.label: Hug Mom & Dad and let the past go

nodes.text: The whole backyard erupts in laughter as Ethan hides his face in embarrassment.
Okay, fair shot—I deserved that one!
Warm arms wrap around you under the string lights—your family closer now than ever before.
We love you, Harper. Thank you for never backing down.
Sometimes being the "difficult" one in the family chat is the only reason everyone makes it home.
AITAH for skipping my brother’s gender reveal? Only if saving his life makes me one.

nodes.headline: Truth Sets Us Free · Finale
nodes.teaser_text: Life without parole for the imposter, warm evening breeze in the yard — a real family toast at last.
